nodes.name: cmd_run
nodes.docstring: Execute the full parse → render pipeline.

nodes.name: start_server
nodes.docstring: Serve the output directory with a local HTTP server and open the browser.

nodes.name: extract
nodes.docstring:
Parse ``source`` from ``file_path`` and return (nodes, edges).

        Both lists must conform to the graph JSON schema:
        - nodes: list of node objects (id, name, type, file, line, ...)
        - edges: list of edge objects (id, source, target, type, ...)

nodes.name: _rel
nodes.docstring: Return file path relative to repo root, normalized to forward slashes.

nodes.name: _node
nodes.docstring: Build a node dict conforming to the graph schema.

nodes.name: _edge
nodes.docstring: Build an edge dict conforming to the graph schema.

nodes.name: _find_all
nodes.docstring: Recursively find all descendant nodes of given types.

nodes.name: _is_component_name
nodes.docstring: React component names start with uppercase.

nodes.name: _collect_hooks
nodes.docstring: Collect all hook calls (use* pattern) within a function body.

nodes.name: _collect_jsx_children
nodes.docstring: Collect all JSX element names used in a component body (render relationships).

nodes.name: _collect_fetch_axios
nodes.docstring: Collect fetch() and axios calls within a function body.

nodes.name: _collect_props_from_params
nodes.docstring: Extract prop names from function parameters (destructuring or single props object).

nodes.name: _handle_top_level
nodes.docstring: Handle function declarations, arrow functions, and export statements.

nodes.name: _extract_docstring
nodes.docstring: Extract the first string literal in a function/class body as docstring.

nodes.name: _extract_params
nodes.docstring: Parse a parameters node into list of {name, type_hint, default_value}.

nodes.name: _extract_return_type
nodes.docstring: Get return type annotation from function definition.

nodes.name: _is_flask_route_decorator
nodes.docstring:
Detect @app.route(...) or @blueprint.route(...) decorators.
    Returns (http_method, route_path) or (None, None).

nodes.name: _collect_calls
nodes.docstring: Recursively collect all function call names within a body node.

nodes.name: _collect_assignments
nodes.docstring: Collect simple variable assignments at the direct function-body scope.

nodes.name: _collect_defined_names
nodes.docstring: Pre-scan: collect all function and class names defined in this file.

nodes.name: _handle_import
nodes.docstring: import foo, import foo as bar

nodes.name: add
nodes.docstring: Add nodes and edges from a single file extraction.

nodes.name: serialize
nodes.docstring: Compute depths, build JSON, and write to disk.

nodes.name: _compute_depths
nodes.docstring:
Entry points (flask_route, react_component at root level) = depth 0.
        Direct callees = depth 1. Nested = depth 2+.
        Uses BFS; circular edges are skipped (already visited).

nodes.name: _mark_circular_edges
nodes.docstring: DFS to detect back-edges (cycles). Marks them with type='circular_call'.

nodes.name: _normalize
nodes.docstring: Normalize path separators to forward slashes for cross-platform consistency.

nodes.name: build_renderer
nodes.docstring:
1. Copy graph-data.json into renderer/public/ so Vite can include it.
    2. Run `npm install` (if node_modules missing).
    3. Run `vite build --outDir <output_dir>`.
    4. If single_file is True, inject graph JSON directly into index.html and clean up loose assets.

nodes.name: collect
nodes.docstring: Return (py_files, jsx_files) — both as absolute Paths.

nodes.name: _load_spec
nodes.docstring: Load pathspec from .gitignore or fall back to built-in list.

nodes.name: _is_ignored
nodes.docstring: Return True if this path matches the ignore spec.

nodes.name: _walk
nodes.docstring: Yield all non-ignored files under directory.
